description: The image displays a donut chart illustrating the results of a study on deception in the context of social engineering attacks, categorized by two levels of ambiguity: "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)". The chart is divided into three colored segments representing different outcomes: "Deceived" (red), "Partially" (yellow), and "Not Deceived" (green). For Ambiguity 1 (Outer), the red "Deceived" segment accounts for 67.6% of the total, the yellow "Partially" segment for 57.9%, and the green "Not Deceived" segment for 10.5%. For Ambiguity 2 (Inner), the red "Deceived" segment is 31.6%, the yellow "Partially" segment is 23.5%, and the green "Not Deceived" segment is 8.8%. The chart includes a legend on the right side that clearly labels each color with its corresponding outcome for both ambiguity levels. The percentages are explicitly labeled within the respective segments of the donut chart.
